analysis:
Integrated the two source-pass analyses and replayed integration source (changelog, addon-hold.md architecture doc, autopilot doc, test doc, reference README, ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift, ProviderLoop+Trust.swift). No concrete security regression is supported by the supplied evidence.

The add-on hold adds a local AF_UNIX IPC surface (~/.darkbloom/runtime/addon.sock), persisted holds, an ownership.lock probe and advisory busy_* fields on register/heartbeat. Per the docs, peers must satisfy a pinned code-signing requirement with hardened runtime and the same uid, the claimed add-on id must equal the verified signer, and leases are bounded to 30-600 s. Same-uid abuse to hold the provider is an availability lever inside the TB-003 operator model (T-059 as added by the PR; A-018, TB-012). The hold does not grant serving authorization and does not stop the App Attest worker, and no provider_drain is sent, so A-016, T-052, T-053 and TB-011 are unaffected. Hold metadata carries no prompts (A-001), keys or tokens. The T-041 cache controls are untouched; the hold's unload keeps loaded-models.json.

The small code diffs are benign: ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift adds an addonHold busy reason and excludes the hold-owned drain from .draining. ProviderLoop+Trust.swift adds an additive addonHold snapshot field to the status view.

The following remain unverified because the sources were not supplied. About 241 integration units were omitted, so deeper review is warranted.
- AddonPeerPolicy, AddonIPCServer and AddonHoldStore internals, including whether any env override of the socket or lock path is honored in release builds.
- ProviderDrain (refusingForServiceChange, takeover and resume semantics).
- Refusal of load_model, prefetch and the local endpoint under a hold.
- Bounds and sanitization of busy_addon on encode and at the coordinator, which ships separately.
- Concurrent-hold and vm_bytes caps.
- State-file permissions for the addonHold snapshot.
- The positive peer check is untested, which the docs state openly. This is a coverage gap, not a finding.
